answers.why: Part of the capture skill, which works as shipped and queues mid-task work, something no reader rule or skill does.

The capture procedure (levels, split, topic, duplicate check, confirm and return) is a plugin workflow skill with nothing like it in the reader; its "nothing added" split rule agrees with examples/reader/rules/engineering.md rule 4.
Capture's rule for queuing and claiming self-assigned work is part of the shipped capture skill and has no reader counterpart.
Rescue session (Roundup) is a shipped capture procedure that the reader has nothing like.
The riffing mode is a shipped capture procedure; it adds no unasked build, so it does not collide with the reader's scope rule.

The herd skill body (pairs, hikes, handoffs, status footer) works as shipped; its "start the reviewer ... on opus" default governs a session the plugin starts, not a subagent dispatch, so examples/reader/rules/engineering.md rule 6 does not apply.
The associate role file belongs to the herd skill and defines a role the reader does not have.
Handoff intro is part of the shipped herd role files and has no reader counterpart.
Retiring-session steps are part of the shipped handoff procedure.
The staying-session steps are part of the shipped handoff procedure.
The new-session steps are part of the shipped handoff procedure.
The handoff chat lines are part of the shipped herd role files; the voice variant is only a pointer.
The reviewer role header is part of the shipped herd skill and sets up a binding second-session review the reader lacks.
Reviewer setup is part of the shipped pair workflow.
The per-review procedure is part of the shipped pair workflow; its "Attack it" step agrees with the reader's verification stance rather than breaking it.
Reviewer limits are part of the shipped pair workflow; "Never use --force" and the no-edit rule fit the reader's hard stops.
Stopping and retiring rules for a started reviewer are part of the shipped pair workflow.

The rigor: build reviewer checklist is part of the shipped herd skill; its revert-and-watch-it-fail check overlaps examples/reader/rules/engineering.md rule 3 but sits inside a role file that works as shipped.
The worker role is the core of the shipped pair workflow and works with meow; it asks for the owner's go-ahead before spending or a deploy, so no safety rule is broken.
The rigor: build worker section is part of the shipped worker role; its five coding rules mostly repeat examples/reader/rules/engineering.md rules 1, 2 and 5, and are not split out from the role.
Intro and command lookup for the voice-toggle skill, which only wraps the voice judged in the other herder units.
The /herder on/off toggle exists only to switch the cat persona, which is voice, off by default.
Cat names and cat voice in chat are persona.
The cat-voice confirmation openers ("Mrrp. Boxed.") are persona.
A one-line goodbye flavour for the persona.
Cat-voice handoff lines duplicate the plain ones in the herd role files and are persona.
A rule about which words the cat voice may use is persona.
The queue skill is the shipped procedure for setting up and using the queue; it asks before setup and before moving the queue, consistent with examples/reader/rules/safety.md rule 5.
Working the queue (claim, ready check, review, groom) is shipped queue procedure; it says "Never use --force on your own" and relays refusals to the owner, matching the reader's stop-and-ask rules.
The overheard block is a shipped reporting format of the queue skill that the reader has no equivalent for.
A single sample ledger bullet that only illustrates the question ledger described in the other queue units.
The question ledger and answer-reading rules are shipped queue procedure; the reader has nothing like them.
The /meow command works as shipped, runs one quoted meow call and nothing else, and has no reader counterpart.
